newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria state food makers post 3.3 bln lev profit.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria state food makers post 3.3 bln lev profit.

text.p: Bulgaria's state-owned food producing firms posted a net profit of 3.336 billion levs for the first half of 1996, an Agriculture Ministry official said.
"The net profit of 255 state-owned firms in the food sector by the end of June this year totalled 3.336 billion levs," the official told a news conference.
The meat-processing industry, the only sector not to post a profit, made a net loss of 198 million levs.
Among the profit-makers were the wine industry with 551 million levs and the breweries with 314 million levs.
The ministry said accumulated losses from previous years amounted to 13.32 billion levs.
Last year 263 state-owned food producing firms posted a pre-tax loss of 1.642 billion levs.
